description: Rhomboid minor forms the narrow band between the nuchal line and scapular spine, a subtle ridge that cues shoulder blade placement in lean models.
actions: Retracts the scapula with precise control, sharpening the root of the scapular spine in back views.
Assists in downward rotation of the scapula, coordinating with levator scapulae for shrugging gestures.
Helps stabilize the scapula against the thorax, preventing winging when the arms are extended.
